bodies: final populations of solo_tape / solo_tree at rates .5 / 1.0, 3 ids, 80 gens (deduplicated)
ruler: relative score loss on a shared item set, per-organism evaluate (no sharing)
manipulations: TAPE: pad (dead-register instructions appended; identity checked) and duplicate
analysis: per substrate: loss ~ 1 + log size + (live regs | depth), standardised, 2000-permutation bands, for fixed-k and fraction-matched; pad/duplicate paired contrasts (fixed-k and fraction)

predictions.CROSS_SUBSTRATE: fixed-k loss falls with size in TAPE (coef below p05) and the pad/duplicate pattern matches P-F01's
predictions.REPRESENTATION_IS_A_COORDINATE: TAPE and TREE disagree in sign
predictions.NOT_PORTABLE: no size coefficient clears its band

material_rule: any size / registers / depth coefficient outside its band, or a pad/duplicate contrast outside its band
